reviews.t: Works Great! For less than 34 days.
reviews.x: When it works it is terrific but that was only for 34 days then it just stopped working. Called Philips directly they were of no help and insisted I must have done something wrong. They went as far as to tell me I have to clean the device each night and I shouldn't fill the reservoir with mouth wash, suggested I was using the wrong type of charger (I use the one that came with the package). Very disheartening Philips went out of their way to place the blame on human error and not the product its

All I can say is that my teeth feel very clean and are whiter after using the toothbrush for a month. I do not care about tooth whiteness but I can't say that I am sorry about it. My gums are considerably less red and swollen.  I really did not believe that I would see a diffrence so quickly. My gums have stopped bleeding while brushing and flossing. Also, I was worried that the air floss would be hard to use. I am actually finding that it is easy to position properly and use and it really takes

reviews.t: Crushes the competition for brushes and flossers!
reviews.x: I've owned a few sonicare and waterpiks in the past, and I bought this looking for an affordable, travel friendly bundle. At first I was disappointed in the toothbrush handle as it starts out in a gentle,lower power mode, but then i read that's just for the first dozen or so uses to accommodate to the brush. The flosser takes a bit to get used to. Before owning this I didn't floss nearly as often as I should, so my gums were bleeding a lot with my first week of use. But it was fast, kind of fun,

This product doesn't live up to expectations.  The flosser puffs air and a little bit of water but doesn't floss or get anything out from between the teeth. I would like to return this product but it contains Lithium batteries which make it near impossible to return due to customs and Lithium batteries.

reviews.t: This set is great and was exactly what I was looking for
reviews.x: This set is great and was exactly what I was looking for. The tooth brush cleans well, and the power flosser goes an excellent job cleaning between the teeth. I was surprised/horrified how much plaque it cleaned out the first time I used it, as I thought I was already practicing a good cleaning routine.  The only down side to the flosser is you can’t choose to have a continuous stream or just a burst, which isn’t a deal breaker. All in all, great product!

Brush heads are a little small but, cordless unit fits my hand well, runs a solid 2 minutes (the recommended amount of time to spend brushing), can be restarted using button on front of unit. Great brand just a little pricey. The powered pik unit shoots little blasts of antibacterial mouthwash or water. It feels good to clean between teeth and around the gums. Both units came together, in the same box.
The toothbrush didn't charge right and when I contacted Phillips they tried to troubleshoot it but no luck so without issue, they sent me a new one.Both pieces work great.

The product does what it was intended to do. The floss system isn't that great since it is unable to get in between the groves like a traditional floss. Must refill with water or mouth wash after each use especially if you are trying to get the gunk out. Floss works great for easier to reach small food particles. Overall I would recommend getting just the toothbrush.

I should have listened to the negative reviews on this air flosser. It charged out of the box and lasted several weeks. But when it was time to charge it wouldn't! The green light blinks a couple times when I set it on the charger but that's it.  The light stops blinking and it won't charge so it's worthless.
Flosser stopped working after 2 weeks of use

reviews.t: Incorrect labeling resulted in sending out the wrong product! As of 11/18/2017, I have not yet received a refund/credit
reviews.x: Something is not right with the labeling. I ordered this because my old Philips Sonicare Airfloss died. I really have grown to depend on this because it does an excellent job of removing stuff from between my teeth. When I saw this kit being advertised, I jumped and ordered it. When it arrived, I was so disappointed because the box had the Airfloss as the only content. The picture on the box just had the Airfloss as well. When I looked at the bottom of the product box, the little sticky label wi

reviews.t: good budget value tooth care kit for single people, but absolutely no fancy features or extras
reviews.x: For the price, this is an excellent basic electric toothbrush and flosser. The two pieces lack the fancy features of more expensive pieces, but my dentist says all those extra features are not worth the money. The toothbrush works great and the only feature my dentist recommends is the 2 minute timer to make sure you give yourself enough time to brush all your teeth. I've always used string floss in the past, but this water flosser seems to work just as well most of the time. Sometimes there is

reviews.t: So far they are great for the price
reviews.x: So far they are great for the price. Only two "issues" are that the reservoir for the mouth wash is a bit small and that there is only one charging base but neither of them are really that big of a deal. That said this is my first electronic toothbrush and air flosser so can't say how they compare to others but they have made a huge difference for me.

The toothbrush is great.  Our family has been using Sonicare for years.  The flosser is just okay.  It has a very small reservoir, which is annoying.  I am also not sure that it is a substitute for flossing.  I am not willing to give up my flossing in exchange for a puff of air.  I think a waterpik would be a better choice.

reviews.t: Completly disappointed. Air floss unusable ffrom the start
reviews.x: Completly disappointed.  Air floss unusable ffrom the start.  Please issue instructions for return.
Great toothbrush. My dentist recommended. Not as impressed with the flosser however. Does not always fit well between teeth, and has a delay, also has small tank.
Flosser stopped working after 2 weeks of use

I gave this two stars because the water pick works fine, but I wanted this package for the electric toothbrush.  That part is just terrible.  It's hard to explain it, but it vibrates in such a way as to being causing me pain.  I can't finish the brushing because of the discomfort.  I feel it in my nerve endings.  I didn't know if it was just me so I asked my wife to try it and I didn't tell her my experience so as to not bias her.  She too found it uncomfortable although not to the extent I did.

reviews.t: Very comfortable even on my first use
reviews.x: If you are thinking of upgrading from your regular toothbrush then this is the way to go. It is not as expensive as the latest models but in my opinion it works just the same. Very comfortable even on my first use.
The “air flosser” is like an assault on your gums.  Not a consistent stream, so you can’t pinpoint area without getting so close to the gum that it hurts.  WASTE of money.

reviews.t: air floss work great for 4 months
reviews.x: air floss work great for 4 months, then died not up to the standard that I  have grown to expect  in a Phillips product

This teeth cleaning kit consisting of an ultrasound toothbrush and a “flosser” was fun to use. The rechargeable toothbrush is comfortable in the hand, requiring no actual conventional brushing. You just hold the toothbrush head over the tooth surface and let the ultrasonic waves do the work. It even gives warning beeps telling the user its time to move on to a new section of your mouth. The unit gradually builds up intensity over multiple sessions so new users can get used to the vibrations. One

reviews.t: Works well when it was broken
reviews.x: I liked the  Airfloss Rechargeable Electric Flosser component in the dual package and it worked very well flossing my teeth.  However, recently as I have been using it ( I use it at least three or more times a day after eating anything), the fluid/mouthwash that I put in the compartment on the flosser started to spray all over the place, especially on my face. reviews.t: 5 Stars for Essence+ BUT 3 Stars for Air Floss
reviews.x: ----- 5 Stars for Essence+ and 3 Stars for Air Floss ----- Many already own and have used either Oral-B electronic brush or Philips Sonicare. They are both better than manual toothbrushes. reviews.t: Not your father's electric tooth brush or water irrigation machine!
reviews.x: Fascinating product; not your father's electric toothbrush, not your father's irrigation water pick.  This is very different electric toothbrush that clearly is different than brushing your teeth, it seems like a much much faster motion and in fact it hums and makes a rather peculiar numbing like sound and feels that way as it is being used. claims.text: Several reviewers report the flosser or toothbrush stopped working or failed to charge within weeks of use.
Many reviewers praise the toothbrush for cleaning well and improving gum health or whiteness.
Some reviewers find the air flosser ineffective, saying it doesn't clean between teeth like traditional floss.
Reviewers frequently note the flosser's small reservoir as a drawback.
Multiple reviewers consider the kit a good value for the price despite lacking fancy features.
